messages:
ana: Heads up — we need a small contract for queueing/batching signals that runtime will emit to the telemetry pipeline. Goal: dashboard + alerting for batch-size distribution, queue wait p50/p95/p99, and node saturation indicator.

devin: Agree. Can we define the minimal fields? Thinking: request_id, model, route, timestamp, batch_size, enqueue_time, dequeue_time, backend_node, queue_length_at_enqueue, backpressure_flag

marcos: Also include `batch_slot_ms` (time between first and last token enter) and `kv_cache_hit` bool? High cardinality danger on backend_node — we should sample or map to node_pool.

claire: For alerts we only need aggregate metrics: per-model p95 wait_time, per-route saturation ratio. Node-level only for SRE drilldowns. So contract -> emit both raw events (sampled) and per-window aggregates.

sunita: Do we have any protobuf schema? Prefer proto over freeform JSON for size and stability. Payload size matters w/ high qps.

ana: proto sounds good. Minimal proto fields we want in first pass (string fields shown):
```proto
message QueueSignal {
  int64 ts_ms = 1;
  string request_id = 2;
  string model = 3;
  string route = 4;
  int32 batch_size = 5;
  int32 queue_len_on_enqueue = 6;
  int32 node_pool_id = 7; // coarse categorization
  int32 enqueue_to_dequeue_ms = 8; // wait time
  int32 batch_span_ms = 9; // when batch completed
  bool kv_cache_hit = 10;
  map<string,string> tags = 11;
}
```

devin: Nice. Implementation notes: runtime can push to telemetry kafka topic `telemetry.queue_signals.v1` with protobuf-encoded messages. We should add a sampling header for tail sampling when qps > X.

marcos: On ingestion side we will 1) decode proto -> store raw (sampled) to object store for traces; 2) ingest aggregates into metrics (prom/statsd) for dashboard. What about cardinality for `route`+`model` combos? We should limit `tags` cardinality.

claire: Panels we want: batch_size histogram (0..64), p50/p95 wait by model, queue saturation ratio (active_queue_len / max_queue_len) over time, and a heatmap of node_pool saturation. Alerts: saturation ratio > 0.9 for 2m, p95 wait > 200ms for 5m.

sunita: Also add `is_fallback` flag (bool) so we can route-policy regressions when requests hit fallback models.

ana: Good call. Let's add `is_fallback` bool field 12.

devin: I'll send a PR to runtime with proto + kafka producer. ETA EOD tomorrow. I might need help adding sampling flag. @marcos will you accept schema change on ingestion?

marcos: Yes. I'll create an ingestion ticket. Need the proto and example messages. Also confirm expected throughput — estimate 10k msg/s at peak with 10% sampling.

ana: Action items:
- devin: PR to runtime (proto + producer + sampling header) — due 1771190000
- marcos: ingestion ticket + example messages + storage plan — due 1771193600
- claire: dashboard panels + alert thresholds draft — due 1771197200
- sunita: add `is_fallback` and validate `kv_cache_hit` semantics — due 1771190000

devin: ack. Will include JSON schema for dev testing too.

ops-bot: deploy queued: telemetry-ingest-service v2.3.1 scheduled for 1771120000 :rocket:

ana: Thanks everyone. We'll sync in the telemetry sync on Friday. :thumbsup:
